summary: Tennessee Division of Forestry tower in Lawrence County, registered 2023 as an 80-foot Aeromotor LS-40; a regional list marks it removed, so current status is disputed.

facts.status_note: Sources disagree on whether it still stands. A 2023 Register visit describes it in place, but a regional list marks it removed with no date. Check before you go.

visit.trail_note: Tucked back in the woods, a short walk from the road (Register visit note, 2023)

events.note: State bought twelve 80-foot steel towers; one was to be erected at this site by early winter (News-Democrat item dated October 7, 1955). Construction date not confirmed.
Register site visit recorded as November 25, 2023

notes_for_editor: Current status is disputed: NHLR (2023 visit, registered Dec 2023) describes it in place; tnlandforms.us lists it as removed with no date. Construction date unknown; the 1955 item only says it was to be erected by early winter. No staffing, access or rental information found in two searches and the cached pages. Access key omitted rather than guessed. The NHLR record reads 80 ft, which matches the record's height_m of 24.4. Two searches used; the Wikipedia article for Westpoint has no tower mention.
